metadata.title: Freight Logistics Orchestration Deployment Channels
metadata.description: Deployment channels and runtime surfaces for shipper, carrier, operations, integration, financial, and intelligence products.

channels.description: Backend runtime for freight platform services.
Backend runtime for shipment state, tendering, matching, pricing, visibility, settlement, risk, automation, and data.
Browser workspaces for shippers, carriers, and freight operations.
Shipper shipment creation, booking, tracking, reporting, document, invoice, and support workspace.
Carrier onboarding, load discovery, booking, tracking, document upload, payment, and scorecard experience.
Brokerage and managed transportation workspace for tendering, tracking, exception recovery, documents, and communications.
EDI, API, file, and webhook exchange with customers and carriers.
EDI, API, file, and webhook gateway for orders, tenders, milestones, documents, appointments, and invoices.
